label: One node type with complemented edges
section: One node type with complemented edges
subgoals: Express every gate with two-input ANDs and complemented edges
Rewrite OR as an AND with complemented inputs and output
Store each node as two fanin literals with complement bits

label: AND counts of common gates
subgoals: Charge one AND node for each two-input AND, OR, NAND or NOR
Charge three AND nodes for each XOR, XNOR or multiplexer
Sum the counts over the netlist when nothing is shared

label: Levels as the delay measure
subgoals: Add one level per AND layer, two for XOR, XNOR and MUX
Take the largest output level as the AIG depth
